\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}[american]
    \ctikzset{european resistors}
    \draw[blue] (0,0) to[vR, name=V, mirror] (2.4,.9)
        to[sR, name=S, mirror] (4.8,1.8);
    \draw[magenta] (V.wiper) circle (.55mm);
    \draw[green!50!black] (S.tip) circle (.55mm);
    \ctikzset{bipoles/fix tunable direction=false}
    \draw[draw=red] (0,-1.8) to[vR, name=E, mirror, fill=blue!65!white] (2.4,-.9);
    \draw[orange] (E.W) circle (.55mm);
    \draw[violet] (E.tip) circle (.55mm);
    \ctikzset{american resistors}
    \draw[red] (2.4,-.9) to[vR, mirror] (4.8,0);
    \draw (0,-3.2) to[R] (2.4,-3.2);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
